scope: Only frozen public argv and baseline public runner source were inspected. No model, official scorer, hidden test, reference patch, task test process or network was used.

limitations.pytest: Paths/node IDs and bounded Boolean -k/-m only; no plugins, arbitrary flags/env/cwd/timeout.
limitations.django: Public dotted test labels only; no -k because conditional support differs across admitted runtimes, no settings/parallel overrides.
limitations.sympy: Public paths and existing -k keyword list only; no pytest :: nodes or arbitrary flags.
limitations.native: Shared launcher is optional convenience through the original terminal. It is not an immutable permission gate or PROJECT delivery evidence.
limitations.coverage: Frontend compile/source compatibility only; no claim that all full suites pass or that every selected test actually executes.
